task.heading: Payment run
task.acknowledge: I have checked every flagged item and its reason
task.acknowledgeError: Tick that you checked the flagged items before approving

decide.confirmText: Approve payment run {label}, total transferred THB {amount}. The decision cannot be changed afterwards
decide.returnHint: The run goes back to a draft for the preparer to change and send again; its documents stay in it
decide.rejectHint: The run is closed and its invoices and retentions are ready for payment again at once
decide.reasonHint: The preparer reads this: say clearly what to change or why the run is not approved

bankChange.heading: Bank account change
bankChange.contactChanged: The supplier’s e-mail or phone in the register changed lately: check with the supplier through the old contact before approving
bankChange.sharedAccount: This account is also the account of a supplier with another tax id

list.title: Payment runs
list.intro: Prepare supplier payment runs, send them for approval under the DOA, make the bank file and record the transfers
list.emptyHint: Start by preparing a payment run: the pay date and the invoices due are proposed for you
list.emptyHintReader: Payment runs that finance prepares appear here
list.emptyTabHint: Choose another tab to see runs in another status
list.forbiddenHint: Payment runs are open to finance, auditors and the approvers of each run. If you should see them, contact your organization admin
list.moduleOff: The organization has not switched on the payment module (PAY). Contact your organization admin to use payment runs

new.title: Prepare a payment run
new.intro: Choose the account that pays and the pay date. Invoices due by the pay date and the retentions ready to release are added, then the draft opens for you to check before sending it for approval
new.payerHint: An account of the company in use; only its last 4 digits are shown
new.payDateHint: The next run day is proposed; you may choose another working day
new.proposedNone: No invoice is due by this pay date yet. Make the draft and add invoices yourself
new.askedRefused: {date} cannot be used: {why} The proposed pay date is shown instead
new.noPayer: There is no payer account in use yet. Ask an admin to add a company account first
new.choosePayer: Choose the account that pays first
new.addFailed: The draft is made, but the proposed documents could not be added: {why} Open the draft to add them yourself
new.forbiddenTitle: You cannot prepare a payment run
new.forbiddenHint: Payment runs are prepared by finance, in an organization with the payment module on

run.title: Payment run {number}
run.numberDraft: No number yet: it is given when the run is sent for approval
run.neutral: A neutral test template, not the format of any bank. No bank will take this file
run.rejected: The approver rejected this run. Its invoices and retentions are ready for payment again
run.readOnly: You can only read this payment run. Account numbers show their last 4 digits only
run.waitingApprover: Waiting for the approver under the DOA
run.waitingPreparer: Only the preparer ({name}) changes and sends this draft
run.forbiddenTitle: You cannot open this payment run
run.forbiddenHint: A payment run is open to finance, auditors and its approvers

items.title: Payments by supplier
items.hint: Flagged items come first. The approver sees the same flags and reasons
items.empty: This draft has no documents yet
items.emptyHint: Press "Add invoices and retentions" to choose documents ready for payment
items.noAccount: The supplier has no approved account. The run cannot be sent until it has one
items.removeTitle: Take a document out of the draft
items.removeText: Take {doc} out of this draft. It becomes ready for payment again and can go into another run
items.reasonNeeded: This flag needs a reason before the run is sent
items.reasonLabel: Reason for the flags (the approver reads it)

sheet.title: Add documents to the run
sheet.hint: Choose invoices ready for payment and retentions ready to release. Each supplier gets one item
sheet.empty: No documents left that are ready for payment
sheet.emptyHint: An invoice is ready for payment once it matches or is approved
sheet.noAccount: This supplier has no approved account yet

draft.title: Send for approval
draft.hint: The pay date, the suppliers’ accounts and the reasons for flags are checked again, then the run goes to its approver under the DOA
draft.submitted: Sent for approval as payment run {number}
draft.reasonsMissing: {count} items still need a reason for their flags before sending
draft.cancelHint: Every invoice and retention becomes ready for payment again. This cannot be undone

dialog.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 3 characters
dialog.notSent: I confirm the file downloaded earlier was not uploaded to the bank
dialog.notSentRequired: Tick to confirm first: a file of this run was downloaded

files.title: Bank files
files.hint: A file never changes. Only the version in use can be downloaded, and every download is recorded
files.emptyApproved: The run is approved: make its file
files.emptyNotYet: The file can be made once the run is approved
files.regenerateTitle: Make a new version of the bank file
files.regenerateHint: The version in use becomes an old file and can no longer be downloaded. Say why it is made again
files.regenerated: New version of the file made
files.downloadedNow: The download has started. Once the file is uploaded to the bank, press "Sent to the bank"
files.markSentHint: Press once the file in use is uploaded to the bank. The system does not send it to the bank
files.markSentNeedsDownload: Download the file in use first; then it can be marked as sent to the bank
files.markSentTitle: Confirm the file was sent to the bank
files.markSentText: Version {version} of the file was uploaded to the bank. The results of the transfers can be recorded after this
files.marked: Marked as sent to the bank
files.revert: Take back sent to the bank
files.revertTitle: Take back sent to the bank
files.revertHint: For a run marked as sent by mistake. Only before any transfer result is recorded
files.reverted: Sent to the bank taken back
files.cancelHint: Every invoice and retention becomes ready for payment again. If a file was downloaded, the next run flags them "Was in a downloaded file". This cannot be undone

results.title: Payment results
results.hint: Record the results from the bank’s transfer report. A result recorded cannot be changed in this phase
results.notYet: Results can be recorded once the run is marked "Sent to the bank"
results.allTitle: All paid except the items chosen
results.allHint: Every item without a result is paid on the transfer date below, except the items marked as failed with a reason
results.ownReference: Reference of this item (if not the one above)
results.confirmText: Paid {paid} items · failed {failed} items. Results recorded cannot be changed; the failed items become ready for payment again
results.completed: Every item has its result: the payment run is completed

advice.title: Payment advice e-mail
advice.off: The organization does not send payment advice e-mails

results.resendHint: The supplier gets the payment advice of this item again, with its 50 ทวิ when there is one. Say why it is sent again

event.payment_run_sent_reverted: Sent to the bank taken back

decide.title: Decide this payment run
decide.ackHint: The flags and the preparer’s reasons are at the top of the Items tab
decide.ackRequired: Tick that you checked the flagged items before approving
decide.flagsChanged: The flags of the run changed after you opened this page and nothing was approved. The page now shows the latest flags: check the flagged items again and tick before approving
decide.reasonRequired: An item has a flag that needs the preparer’s reason and has none, so nothing was approved. Return the run for the preparer to give the reason
decide.dateInvalid: The pay date of this run has passed or is not a working day, so nothing was approved. Return the run for the preparer to change the date

errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came from the server. Check the connection and press the same button again: it is done only once
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and try once more
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this on the payment run. Only its preparer changes a draft, and only finance works on the file and the results
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: The organization has not switched on the payment module (PAY). Contact your organization admin
errors.NOT_FOUND: The payment run or the document is no longer there. Reload the page to see where it stands
errors.STATE: The payment run is in another status now, so this cannot be done. Reload the page to see where it stands
errors.RESULTS_RECORDED: Results of transfers are recorded already, so sent to the bank cannot be taken back
errors.CHANGED: Someone changed this payment run after you opened the page. Reload it and try again
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other values. Reload the page and try again
errors.BUSY: Someone is working on this payment run right now. Wait a moment and try again
errors.DATE_PAST: The pay date has passed. Choose today or a later working day
errors.DATE_NOT_BUSINESS_DAY: The pay date is a holiday. Choose a working day
errors.NO_WORKING_DAY: No working day to pay on within a year. Ask an admin to check the business calendar and the run weekdays
errors.PAYER_NOT_ACTIVE: This payer account is no longer in use. Choose another account
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_PAYABLE: Document {number} is not ready for payment or is in another payment run. Reload the page and choose again
errors.PAYMENT_ITEM_NOT_POSITIVE: The transfer to {supplier} must be more than 0. Add an invoice or take out what makes it negative
errors.BANK_ACCOUNT_NOT_APPROVED: Supplier {supplier} has no approved bank account. Take its documents out, or propose its account first
errors.PAYMENT_FLAG_REASON_REQUIRED: The item of {supplier} has a flag that needs a reason. Give the reason before sending
errors.PAYMENT_FLAGS_CHANGED: The flags of the payment run changed after you opened the page. Reload it and check again
errors.BANK_FILE_CHECK_FAILED: The check before the file failed ({checks}) and no file was made. Check the suppliers’ accounts and the documents of the run, or cancel it and prepare it again
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_BUILT: There is no builder for this bank’s template yet. Contact the system admin
errors.EXPORT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: A file of this run was downloaded. Tick to confirm it was not sent to the bank first
errors.FILE_NOT_DOWNLOADED: The file in use was not downloaded yet. Download it first, then mark it as sent to the bank
errors.FILE_NOT_CURRENT: Only the file in use of a run not finished can be downloaded
errors.PAID_ON_BEFORE_PAY_DATE: The transfer date cannot be before the run’s pay date
errors.PAID_ON_FUTURE: The transfer date cannot be after today
errors.ADVICE_EMAIL_OFF: The organization does not send payment advice e-mails, so it cannot be sent again
errors.EMPTY: A payment run pays one supplier at least. Add documents before sending
errors.REASON: Write a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.REFERENCE: The reference is longer than 100 characters
errors.SOD: You may not do this because you changed an account the run pays into ({rule}). Ask another finance member to prepare this run
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: There is no DOA for payment runs yet. Contact your organization admin
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver was found under the DOA. Ask an admin to check who holds the positions
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: There is no higher approver under the DOA for this run. Contact your organization admin
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: The organization has no departments yet. Contact your organization admin
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved because of a system error (reference {requestId}). Try again, or give this reference to the admin
errors.FAILED: Not saved. Try again, or contact the system admin
